description: Java class implementing accounting rule write platform service with methods for creating, updating, and deleting accounting rules, handling data integrity issues, and managing account tags.

classes.name: AccountingRuleWritePlatformServiceJpaRepositoryImpl
classes.description: Implementation of accounting rule write platform service with methods for CRUD operations and tag management.

methods.name: handleAccountingRuleIntegrityIssues
methods.description: Handles data integrity issues during accounting rule operations, throwing specific exceptions based on error messages.

methods.name: createAccountingRule
methods.description: Creates a new accounting rule based on JSON command input, with validation and exception handling.

methods.name: assembleAccountingRuleAndTags
methods.description: Assembles an AccountingRule object from JSON input, including debit/credit accounts or tags.

methods.name: updateAccountingRule
methods.description: Updates an existing accounting rule with new data, handling account and tag changes.

methods.name: determineCreditTagToAddAndRemoveOldTags
methods.description: Determines which tags to add or remove during update operations.

methods.name: retrieveExistingTagIds
methods.description: Retrieves IDs of existing tags associated with an accounting rule.

methods.name: deleteAccountingRule
methods.description: Deletes an accounting rule by ID.

methods.name: saveDebitOrCreditTags
methods.description: Creates and adds tag rules for debit or credit tags from input.
